Completed challenges appear here as you care for your plants.

You’ve earned %1$d points in total. Badges unlock automatically based on this total.
Complete a watering task in To-do, Calendar, or the plant’s profile after you water it.
Open a plant’s profile from My Garden to view its information.
Add a Light check task to a plant’s profile. Complete the task after you check the plant’s light.
Complete a care task on three different days. Each day counts once.
In a plant’s profile, add watering tasks for two different upcoming dates for that plant. The dates will appear in Calendar.
Add three plants to My Garden.
Complete a watering task for two different plants after you water each one.
Schedule a care task for today or later for each of three different plants.
Complete a Watering task, a Light check task, and an Other care task for the same plant. For the Other task, try checking the leaves or cleaning the pot.
Earn points in Challenges. Unlock a pot here, then choose it from a plant in My Garden.
Buy a background to apply it to your garden. Switch between unlocked backgrounds in Customize.
